 The role involves creating strategic collaterals and communication for institutional investors and analysts, along with detailed benchmarking of industry and other FMCG companies to input into internal strategy and decision making. By developing these materials and undertaking various analyses, the role aims to deliver by strengthening the value of the Company to its investors and serving as a catalyst to improve strategic and financial decision making.
 Support the Investor Relations function in driving a strong valuation premium for Company through effective communication of the Company's strategy, business performance, and long-term vision to investors, analysts, and other external stakeholders.

 - Provide timely and accurate analytical support for investor and analyst engagement.

 - Continuously benchmark investor messaging, disclosures, presentations, and engagement practices of leading FMCG and consumer companies.

title: Demand Planning SME - o9 IBP & SOE
description:
Job Description Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondel z International Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Possible. You will develop the 0-24-month IBP forecast by brand and at the stock keeping unit (SKU) level. You will coordinate, challenge and influence building block with input from sales, marketing and other partners. In addition, you will review the disaggregated short-term demand plan, which includes SKU/location mix and weekly pacing. Finally, you will provide the finalized detailed demand plan by SKU to supply planners and adjust it based on feedback from supply planners or commercial teams. How you will contribute You will: Contribute to the demand management cycle of the integrated business planning (IBP) process for your categories and to strategy and structure discussions Liaise with the commercial and operational teams and develop ways to continuously improve communication between the functions to support the delivery of the business KPIs for their families Manage forecast compilation process, which includes owning the short-term weekly plan and the long-term forecast (three or more months) Interact with modelling team to generate statistical forecasting Participate in the integrated business planning process and manage the demand planning tool Perform root-cause analysis for continuous plan improvement for key service issues, forecast error and bias, and share output with appropriate leadership What you will bring A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge: Experience in a fast-moving consumer goods or consumer packaged goods environment, preferably in food or other fast moving, dynamic industry where shelf life is a constraint Experience within an IBP/S&OP environment Able to influence cross-functional teams, working on priorities and improving the plan Excellent problem-solving skills, analytical skills - and able to understand and interpret data Strong verbal and written communication skills Team player who can work with many other functions on a daily basis More about this role What you need to know about this position: You will be an integral part of the implementation and go-live of the new planning solution (o9) within the AMEA region, with a primary focus on executing Integration Testing (I Test), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), data validation, and end-user training. You will work closely with the BU Champion and regional SME leads to ensure the solution is thoroughly tested, validated, and ready for business adoption. Meanwhile, as an early foundation of demand analysis role, this role would require business insights to deep dive into forecast error reasons and improve the AIML/Operation fcst KPI with BU team. 
 What extra ingredients you will bring: Solid understanding of Demand Planning processes (statistical forecasting, consensus planning, demand sensing) 4-8 years of relevant experience in Supply Chain Planning or a related operational role Familiarity with planning tools/systems; exposure to advanced planning solutions (o9, Kinaxis, OMP, SAP IBP) is a necessity. Strong attention to detail - ability to execute test scripts methodically and identify data discrepancies Comfortable working with testing tools (qTest, Jira) and documenting test results and defects Good communication skills - ability to train and support peers in a clear, structured manner Collaborative mindset with ability to work in cross-functional, multi-market teams under tight timelines Growth mindset, quick learner, and comfortable navigating ambiguity in a fast-paced transformation environment Proficiency in English; additional regional language skills are a plus 
 Education / Certifications: Bachelors Degree or postgraduate. With relevant Demand planning experience. 
 Job specific requirements: The Demand Planning SME will serve as the BUs dedicated testing and adoption resource for the o9 Demand Planning module. Reporting into the region DP transformation lead, this role is responsible for executing test scripts, validating data integrity, supporting training delivery, and ensuring seamless transition from testing to go-live. The SME will act as the first line of support for end users, bridging the gap between the technical implementation team and the business, and championing user confidence and adoption of the new platform. 
 Testing & Validation Execute Integration Test (iTest) and UAT test scripts end-to-end for Demand Planning processes, ensuring 100% script coverage as per the test strategy Validate pre-load and post-load data accuracy during User Cutover Testing (UCUT), flagging discrepancies and coordinating resolution with the data and cutover teams Perform security role validation - test user access, roles, and permissions ahead of each testing phase Log, track, and follow up on defects in qTest/Jira, ensuring timely resolution within SLA and supporting retesting of failed test cases Execute E2E (End-to-End) scenario testing including cross-stream scenarios with Data Science, Supply Planning, and IBP Support pre-test preparation including batch job readiness, test script pre-requisites documentation, and environment checks Participate in daily testing war rooms, morning kick-offs, and end-of-day recaps to report progress, blockers, and pass rates Training & Change Adoption Support the delivery of Pre-UAT and UAT training sessions for BU end users, including o9 system basics, Day-in-the-Life (DILO) walkthroughs, and advanced DP system training Conduct shadow testing sessions - walk end users through test scripts and o9 navigation to build familiarity and confidence Act as a go-to resource for end users during testing phases, providing real-time guidance on o9 processes and ways of working Support the BU Champion in driving change management activities, user communications, and adoption governance Contribute to training material review and localization for BU-specific contexts Go-Live & Sustainment Support Parallel Run execution - assist end users in running DILO/MILO cycles using real business cases to validate outcomes Participate in BU Readiness Checkpoints and contribute to UAT sign-off documentation Provide hypercare support post go-live, acting as the first point of contact for end-user queries and issues Document lessons learned, process gaps, and improvement opportunities from testing phases to feed into sustainment planning Support the institutionalization of new ways of working and standard operating procedures in the o9 platform Demand Analysis Support High data quality management before modelling run - co-work with market planner and stakeholder to set foundation of master data, transaction and driver data. Closely working with data scientists to maintain the highest degree of forecast at item and planning accounts level based on industry trends and demand patterns. Conduct forecast review and analysis to assess demand trends, measure forecast accuracy, recommend data-driven adjustments. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support product lifecycle milestones, ensuring accurate demand planning for new items. Propose and implement forecasting improvements to enhance demand accuracy and efficiency. Partner with market planners to review KPIs, gather market insights, and translating market insights into actionable forecast adjustments. Monitor and ensure KPI metrics consistently meet business goals. Provide weekly performance recaps, including ASE performance reviews, root cause analysis, and action plans aligned with business operations. No Relocation support available Business Unit Summary Headquartered in Singapore, Mondel z International s Asia, Middle East and Africa (AMEA) region is comprised of six business units, has more than 21,000 employees and operates in more than 27 countries including Australia, China, Indonesia, Ghana, India, Japan, Malaysia, New Zealand, Nigeria, Philippines, Saudi Arabia, South Africa, Thailand, United Arab Emirates and Vietnam. Seventy-six nationalities work across a network of more than 35 manufacturing plants, three global research and development technical centers and in offices stretching from Auckland, New Zealand to Casablanca, Morocco. Mondel z International in the AMEA region is the proud maker of global and local iconic brands such as Oreo and belVita biscuits, Kinh Do mooncakes, Cadbury, Cadbury Dairy Milk and Milka chocolate, Halls candy, Stride gum, Tang powdered beverage and Philadelphia cheese. We are also proud to be named a Top Employer in many of our markets. Mondel z International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Job Summary We are seeking a highly skilled and analytical Senior MIS Executive to join our Back Office Operations team in Worli, Mumbai. The ideal candidate should have advanced proficiency in MS Excel, Google Sheets, Google Apps Script, SQL, databases, Looker Studio, Odoo and AI tools. The role will involve developing MIS reports, dashboards, Flow Management Systems (FMS), checklists, database-driven applications, and automation solutions to improve operational efficiency.  1. MIS, Reporting & Dashboard Management Develop, maintain, and manage MIS reports and dashboards using MS Excel and Google Sheets. Create management dashboards for KPIs, operational performance, productivity, pending activities, and business performance. Build dynamic reports using advanced formulas, Pivot Tables, Power Query, and other data-analysis tools. Develop dashboards and visualizations using Looker Studio. Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely availability of MIS reports. Analyze large datasets and provide meaningful business insights to management. 2. Excel & Google Sheets Automation Utilize advanced Excel functions including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, HLOOKUP, INDEX & MATCH, ARRAYFORMULA, QUERY, FILTER, SUMIFS/COUNTIFS, Dynamic Arrays, Macros/VBA, and Power Query. Use Google Sheets for collaborative data management and real-time reporting. Develop automated data-processing and reporting solutions using Google Apps Script. Flow Management Systems (FMS) & Checklist Development Design, develop, and maintain Flow Management Systems (FMS) for operational processes. Create digital checklists for different departments and business processes. Automate task assignment, scheduling, reminders, escalations, status tracking, and completion monitoring. Develop systems for Doers, Process Coordinators, Auditors, designated users, delegations, recurring tasks, and pending activities. Write SQL queries for data extraction, reporting, validation, reconciliation, and analysis. Create and maintain SQL database structures based on business requirements. Create SQL tables, columns, relationships, indexes, and other database objects. Import, clean, transform, and manage data within SQL databases. Maintain data integrity, accuracy, and consistency. Implement primary keys, foreign keys, relationships, constraints, and basic database normalization. Create views, stored procedures, and other database objects where required. Troubleshoot database and query-related issues. 5. Frontend & Database Integration Connect frontend applications with SQL databases to create database-driven business applications. Develop or support frontend interfaces for adding data, updating records, searching information, viewing reports, tracking status, managing assignments, and uploading supporting documents. Create APIs or backend services where required to securely connect frontend applications with databases. Ensure proper data flow between Frontend, Backend/API, SQL Database, and Dashboard/Reports. Implement validation and error handling to maintain data quality. Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or other relevant frontend technologies as required. Convert operational requirements into simple and user-friendly digital systems . 6. AI Integration & Automation Utilize AI tools and technologies to improve data processing and operational efficiency. Use AI for data analysis, report generation, forecasting, data validation, process automation, error identification, documentation, and business insights. Implement AI-based solutions that reduce repetitive manual work. Use AI development tools to accelerate system development, debugging, documentation, and process improvement. 7. ERP & Business Data Management Extract and analyze data from ERP systems. Understand ERP data structures and relationships. Create SQL queries and reports to support business requirements. Reconcile ERP data with MIS reports and operational data. Identify data inconsistencies and coordinate with relevant teams for resolution. 8. Program Requirements Apply knowledge and skills gained from the Tech Mastery program by Rahul Jain. Implement best practices and methodologies learned from the MBT program by Sanjeev Jain. Effectively utilize the tools, resources, and methodologies provided through the Tech Alumni by Sanjeev Jain. Continuously upgrade technical knowledge and apply new technologies to business processes. 9. Communication & Management Reporting Ensure clear and effective communication within the MIS team and with other departments. Understand business requirements and convert them into practical MIS/system solutions. Prepare and present reports and dashboards to management. Explain data, trends, exceptions, and business insights clearly and concisely. Maintain decent spoken English for effective internal and external communication. 10. Operational Support & Process Improvement Provide operational support related to MIS, reporting, databases, and business systems. Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to MIS reports, automation, scripts, databases, and applications. Identify repetitive manual processes and recommend automation opportunities. Continuously improve existing systems and workflows. Support digital transformation initiatives across the organization. 
 Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or a related field. Advanced proficiency in MS Excel and Google Sheets. Strong knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Knowledge of Odoo ERP and its business modules. Knowledge of Google Apps Script for FMS and checklist development. Basic to intermediate knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Understanding of frontend-to-database integration. Experience with Looker Studio. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Experience working with ERP databases. Experience using AI tools for data analysis, automation, and operational efficiency. Decent spoken English and effective communication skills.

title: Strategy & Business Analytics Manager
description:
Role Overview We are looking for a high-calibre Strategy & Business Analytics professional to work closely with the CEO and senior leadership team on strategic business initiatives, financial analysis, business performance, and data-driven decision-making. The role will involve working across business, finance, credit, operations, risk, collections, and technology to analyse business performance, identify opportunities, support strategic decision-making, and drive key initiatives. The ideal candidate would have a combination of strong analytical capability, commercial understanding, structured problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills . A CA + MBA profile with experience in a reputed consulting or professional-services organisation such as EY, Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, or similar would be preferred. Alternatively, an engineer with strong analytical/business experience and preferably fintech exposure can be considered. Key Responsibilities1. Strategic Business Analysis Work closely with the CEO and leadership team on strategic business priorities and key initiatives. Analyse business performance and identify key trends, opportunities, risks, and areas requiring management attention. Develop structured analysis and recommendations to support business decisions. Conduct market, competitor, product, and business-model analysis as required. Support evaluation of new business opportunities, products, partnerships, and growth initiatives. 2. Business & Financial Analytics Analyse key business and financial metrics to understand business performance and profitability. Develop financial/business models to evaluate different scenarios and strategic decisions. Analyse revenue, costs, margins, customer acquisition, portfolio performance, productivity, and other relevant business metrics. Track actual performance against business plans, budgets, and strategic targets. Identify key drivers impacting business performance and provide actionable insights to leadership. 3. Management Reporting & Business Reviews Prepare management-level analysis and presentations for CEO and senior leadership reviews. Develop structured dashboards and performance reports covering key business metrics. Consolidate information from multiple functions and translate data into meaningful business insights. Support monthly/quarterly business reviews and strategic performance discussions. 4. Cross-Functional Strategic Initiatives Work with Business, Finance, Credit, Risk, Operations, Collections, Product, and Technology teams on strategic projects. Drive special projects assigned by the CEO/leadership team from analysis through execution. Coordinate with stakeholders to identify issues, develop solutions, and track implementation. Monitor progress of strategic initiatives and highlight key dependencies, risks, and outcomes. 5. Business Planning & Forecasting Support annual operating plans, budgets, forecasts, and long-term business plans. Build scenario analysis and sensitivity models to assess potential business outcomes. Support leadership in evaluating growth, profitability, cost optimisation, and resource-allocation decisions. Track business performance against agreed objectives and highlight variances. 6. Process & Performance Improvement Identify opportunities to improve business processes, operating efficiency, and profitability. Use data and analytics to identify bottlenecks and areas for improvement. Work with functional teams to develop and implement improvement initiatives. Establish appropriate metrics/KPIs to measure the effectiveness of business initiatives. Key Skills & Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills . Ability to understand complex business problems and structure them into actionable solutions. Strong financial and commercial acumen. Excellent Excel and financial-modelling skills. Strong presentation and communication skills. Ability to work with large datasets and derive meaningful insights. Strong stakeholder-management and cross-functional collaboration skills. Ability to independently drive strategic projects. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving fintech environment . High attention to detail with the ability to maintain a broader strategic perspective. Preferred Candidate ProfilePreferred Profile – CA + MBA Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA) with an MBA from a reputed institution. 5–10 years of experience in strategy, consulting, financial advisory, business analytics, corporate finance, or related areas. Experience with a reputed consulting/professional-services organisation such as EY, Deloitte, PwC, KPMG, or similar preferred. Strong experience in financial analysis, business modelling, strategic projects, and management reporting. Exposure to financial services, fintech, lending, NBFC, banking, or related sectors will be an advantage. Alternative Profile – Engineering + Analytics B.E./B.Tech or equivalent engineering degree. 5–10 years of strong analytical/business experience . Experience in business analytics, strategy, consulting, product analytics, financial analytics, or business planning. Fintech/digital lending/financial-services exposure preferred . Strong Excel, data analysis, business modelling, and problem-solving skills. Demonstrated ability to work with senior stakeholders and drive strategic initiatives. Qualification Preferred: CA + MBA Alternative: B.E./B.Tech with strong analytical/business experience. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who can operate as a thought partner to the CEO and leadership team , rather than someone focused only on routine reporting. The individual should be able to: Understand the numbers identify the business issue analyse the root cause develop options present insights drive the initiative to execution. The role requires a combination of financial acumen, strategic thinking, analytical ability, business understanding, and execution orientation . Ideal Industry Background Candidates from the following backgrounds can be considered: Fintech Digital Lending NBFC Banking / Financial Services Management Consulting Big 4 / Professional Services Corporate Strategy Business Analytics Corporate Finance / FP&A Financial Advisory Fintech experience is preferred but not mandatory for the CA + MBA profile. For the engineering profile, fintech/financial-services exposure would be strongly preferred.

Unlike traditional tools, Computer unifies all your data sources, tools, and workflows into a single AI-ready platform, giving employees real-time insights, proactive suggestions, and powerful agentic actions. It extends your existing software with AI-native apps and agents that work alongside your teams and customers - updating workflows, coordinating across teams, and eliminating repetitive work. We call this Team Intelligence: human-AI collaboration that breaks down silos, brings people back together, and frees you to solve bigger problems. Backed by Khosla Ventures and Mayfield with $150M+ raised, DevRev is trusted by global companies across industries. You will be expected to employ your creativity and expertise to ideate and shape how AI, analytics and workflows are used in customers processes. 
 
 What Youll Do: Customer-facing: 80% working directly with customers. Coding & Integration: 70-80% hands-on technical implementation Build & Deploy Solutions: Design, develop, and launch AI agents, integrations, and automations that connect DevRev with customers existing tech stacks and workflows. Integrate Systems: Connect DevRev with SaaS and non-SaaS platforms through APIs, webhooks, and real-time communication architectures for seamless data flow. Optimize AI Performance: Apply prompt engineering, fine-tune semantic search engines, and leverage generative AI techniques to enhance agent accuracy and user experience. Own Data Insights: Write SQL queries, perform data analysis, and build dashboards to surface insights that drive customer decision-making. Prototype & Iterate: Develop rapid proofs-of-concept, conduct live technical demos, and refine solutions based on customer and stakeholder feedback. Lead Cross-functional Collaboration: Maintain constant communication loops with customers, engineering, product, customer success, support, and revenue teams to ensure alignment. Travel Ready: Willingness to travel up to 80% for on-site implementations, technical workshops, and customer engagements. What You Bring: Experience: 5+ years in software development, systems integration, or platform engineering. Customer-facing experience is a plus. Background: Bachelors or Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field. (Nice to have: Go) Applied AI Knowledge: Familiarity with large language models (LLMs), prompt engineering, frameworks like RAG and function calling, and building evals to validate agentic AI solutions. Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

 **Job Description**  

We are looking for a Data Modeler to help us unlock our vast amounts of data with modelling and advanced analytics, allowing us to make smarter decisions and deliver even better products to our clients. Your primary focus will be in applying data mining techniques, doing statistical analysis, and building high\-quality prediction systems and automated scores using machine learning, integrated with our products. You will also support our business teams, pre\-sales and analytics to ensure product creation.


Suited to someone who has 3\+ years of experience core analytics function of a large bank / consulting firm and with experience handling large data volumes using data analysis tools and generating good data insights.

**What you'll do**

* You'll play an important role to Engage Business/Technical Consultants and delivery teams so that there is a shared understanding and agreement as to deliver proposed solution
* You will Use analysis and customer insights to develop value propositions for customers

  

**Qualifications** **What you'll need to bring to the party**

* Understanding of machine learning techniques and algorithms, such as Gradient Boost, KNN, etc.
* Knowledge of different modelling frameworks like Linear Regression, Logistic Regression, Decision Tree
* Decent understanding and hands\-on of statistical modelling/data analysis tools especially Python, Pyspark or SAS and market trends Applied statistics skills, such as distributions, statistical testing, regression etc.
* Understanding of decisioning and portfolio management in banking and financial services would be added advantage
* Understanding of credit bureau would be an added advantage

 JOB PURPOSE: Analyst BI Analytics will be responsible for conducting statistical analysis and highlighting areas of concerns in terms of Contact Centre statistical parameters; and providing regular analytics support to the team and external stakeholders. 
 PRINCIPAL ACCOUNTABILITIES:

 II. To provide analytics support to stakeholders Interfaces with stakeholders to better interpret their business needs and translates them into application and operational requirements. Interfaces with stakeholders to validate business requirements/requests for analysis and presents intermediate and final analytical results. Interfaces with MIS and Automation team members to translate analytical results into requirements for new and/or existing applications/tools and works to ensure high quality and stable implementations.

Prepare documentation for developed models and provide analysis support for business strategies. Performs end-to-end analytics and reporting solutions that include data analysis, cleansing, ETL, modelling, development, testing, and implementation. Develops analytical approaches to meet business requirements. This involves translating requests into database queries, analysing data, mining data and transforming results into actionable reports, data visualizations, and interactive user interfaces.

Performs end-to-end analytics that include data analysis, cleansing, ETL with Python, modelling, development, testing, and implementation Knows how to do large scale data mining (multi-million row data sets), reporting and knowledge discovery. Demonstrates strong Excel capabilities, with pivot tables, data tables, excel functions and scenario modelling. Knows how to work with VBA in EXCEL.
